header.title: SME Financing & Capital Matcher
header.description: Data-grounded capital readiness analysis and objective financing comparisons for small and mid-sized enterprises

banner.title: Objective Decision Support — Zero Invented Loan Guarantees
banner.description: FinPilot evaluates your borrowing readiness strictly against your verified MongoDB financial records. Options shown are illustrative market structures with transparent underwriting criteria. FinPilot is an analytical tool and does not process loan applications, guarantee approvals, or receive lender commissions.

purposesDesc.working_capital: Smooth operational cash fluctuations, manage payroll, or bridge seasonal revenue dips.

purposesDesc.equipment_purchase: Acquire capital equipment, vehicles, or software where the asset serves as security.
purposesDesc.inventory_purchase: Pre-purchase bulk raw materials or seasonal merchandise ahead of peak order cycles.
purposesDesc.growth_expansion: Open a new regional depot, expand warehouse square footage, or launch a product line.
purposesDesc.debt_refinancing: Restructure existing short-term obligations into lower-cost, extended amortization terms.
